name: Avenge
oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if a player attacked you during their last turn.
Destroy all creatures. You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
blocked_sentences: This spell costs {2} less to cast if a player attacked you during their last turn.
You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.

needs.what: a condition (usable in a cost_reduction's `condition`) that is true when any player attacked you (declared an attacker against you) during that player's most recent turn, requiring a per-player record of whom they attacked on their last turn that persists across turns
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction with `amount` needs a condition, but condition_keys has nothing about past turns; the value `attacked_this_turn` and selector `attacked_this_turn` only see the current turn, and a sorcery cast in your main phase is never in the attacker's turn
